subject: CAIQ control-claim validation + evidence queue for BlueWave procurement
messages:
From: Claire Zhao <claire@bluewave.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluewave.com, Mike Turner <mike.turner@bluewave.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: CAIQ: request to validate control claims + evidence handoff

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking the call last week. BlueWave is moving into final procurement review and our security team needs a short validation of Redwood's CAIQ claims ahead of the SOW signing. Specifically we need:

- A simple control-to-evidence crosswalk for the controls listed in the attached CAIQ excerpt (we've highlighted 18 controls in scope).
- Representative runtime logs showing tenant segregation and KV cache isolation for inference requests (sample window: 2027-01-20 to 2027-01-22).
- Confirmation of key rotation policy for customer-managed KMS and any HSM integrations.

Can you provide an owner for each of these artifacts and an estimated delivery date? If possible we'd like an initial package by EOD Feb 10 so our legal/procurement team can proceed.

Claire
Claire Zhao
Senior Security Program Manager
BlueWave Systems

Attachment: highlighted_caiq_excerpt.pdf (pdf)

From: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@bluewave.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request to validate control claims + evidence handoff

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the highlighted excerpt. Looping in the owners to pick this up. Quick plan below: 

- Marissa (CS): will produce the CAIQ control-to-evidence crosswalk and narrative for each highlighted control. Target: Feb 10 midday.
- Jonas (Research/Telemetry): will extract a sanitized runtime log sample (tenant id scrubbed) showing request routing, cache hits, and KV isolation. Target: Feb 10 EOD.
- Priyom (Security/Platform): will confirm KMS/HSM rotation docs and attach the rotation policy PDF and a short note on customer-managed key integration steps. Target: Feb 9 EOD.

If anything slips we'll call out partial deliverables. Evelyn — I'll drop the artifacts once received into a shared Drive and send a DocuSign/DocReview link if you need non-public access.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Note: internal owners — please confirm the timelines and flag any blockers (esp. logs extraction and redaction).

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Feb 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request to validate control claims + evidence handoff

All — confirmed. Quick notes from my side: 

- KMS/HSM rotation policy (attached) documents our 90-day rotation cadence for ephemeral keys and annual rotation for root material. It also includes the customer-managed KMS onboarding checklist.
- No additional approvals required for sharing the sanitized runtime logs as long as tenant identifiers are redacted and we remove IP addresses; Jonas please follow the standard redaction script.
- I will review the CAIQ crosswalk for any claim language that could be misinterpreted by procurement and suggest tighter phrasing where needed.

Attachments: kms-rotation-policy.pdf (pdf)

Priyom Das
Staff Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@bluewave.com>, evelyn_hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: request to validate control claims + evidence handoff

Claire — attaching the initial package and short notes below. Deliverables included: 

1) CAIQ crosswalk spreadsheet (bluewave_caiq-crosswalk.xlsx) — each control row maps to Redwood's assertion, the supporting artifacts, owner, and a short comment on scope/residual risk. See tab "Highlighted Controls" for the 18 controls you flagged.

2) Runtime log sample (redwood-runtime-log-sample.txt) — 24-hour window redacted as agreed. Contains examples of request routing metadata, model variant fallback entries, and KV cache hit/miss annotations.

3) KMS/HSM rotation policy (kms-rotation-policy.pdf) — policy summary and onboarding checklist for customer-managed keys.

Notes: we called out one control (CCM-IG-7) where BlueWave's expected isolation profile differs from Redwood's multi-tenant default; Marissa added an optional mitigations paragraph and a suggested configuration for Dedicated capacity if you need stronger tenancy guarantees.

If you'd like, we can schedule a short 30-minute walkthrough tomorrow to talk through any questions and run through the crosswalk.

Links: Drive package: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1AbCdeExampleLink
Jira: https://redwood-inference.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-412

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Applied Engineer, Telemetry
Redwood Inference

Attachments: bluewave_caiq-crosswalk.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-runtime-log-sample.txt (text), kms-rotation-policy.pdf (pdf)
